newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner advises buy on Telekom shares.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner advises buy on Telekom shares.

text.p: German bank Dresdner Bank AG said on Monday it was advising private investors to buy shares in newly-floated Deutsche Telekom AG on the open market.

Dresdner, one of the global coordinators of the issue, said the allotment of the issue, which had been five times oversubscribed, had meant that a lot of investors had ended up with fewer shares than they applied for.
"Dresdner recommends that funds put aside (for the issue) should be invested in Telekom shares in the market," it said in a statement.
Telekom shares were priced at 28.50 marks on Sunday. They have been trading in the "grey market" of unofficial trade at around 33 marks.
Official trade in the stock starts in Frankfurt at 0930 GMT on Monday. A first official price quotation is due around two hours later.
